newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates lightly quoted.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates lightly quoted.

text.p: U.S. barge rates remained lightly quoted Friday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session. There were no trades versus none Thursday.
- One barge, lower Mississippi (Dorena), constructive placement April 28, bid 85 percent of tariff, offered 90 - no comparison on either value.
- Eight barges, Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), two barges each week of October, no bid, offered 195 percent - unchanged.
- Eight barges, mid-Mississippi (McGregor and south), two each week of October, bid 220 percent - no comparison, no offer.
- Four barges, Ohio, one each week of October, bid 220 percent - no comparison, no offer.
